name: Aging
description: By a sunlit window, decades pass across the subject's face in a few seconds.
scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} sits by a tall window in a quiet old apartment in the afternoon, turned three-quarters toward the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, hands resting in {their} lap, a calm look. Soft daylight falls through sheer curtains, dust floats in the light, and a houseplant and an old wooden chair sit in the softly blurred room behind. Medium close-up at eye level, the {subject} on the right third, the window on the left. Cinematic portrait photography, soft window light from the left, warm gentle tones, shallow depth of field. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, a softly blurred plain room throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY sits still by the window, eyes on a point just past the camera, breathing slowly. Decades pass across {their} face and hands in one continuous flow while the pose stays the same: fine lines appear and deepen around the eyes and the mouth, the hair turns grey and then silver-white, the skin grows thinner and softer with age spots, the cheeks settle, until by the last second the {subject} is about eighty years old, still recognisably the same person, with the same calm look. The window light shifts slowly from afternoon to golden evening. The camera pushes in very slowly. Sound: a steady ticking clock that slowly stretches, a soft breeze at the curtains, quiet room tone. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, natural aging with real skin and hair detail, sharp detail, stable picture.

The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a steady ticking clock that slowly stretches, quiet room tone.
